post.originalText:
gave Opus 5.5 a single prompt 🎬

"make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out."

this is what it made. kinetic type, shape morphs, 3,000 particles, a 3D cube, all cut on the beat

every frame is code. 0 After Effects
